sentences.text: The type species Transylvanosaurus platycephalus is known only from a fragmentary skull.
This fossil material consists of a fragmentary skull containing an articulated basicranium and frontals.
The holotype specimen was discovered in 2007 in the Pui Beds of the Haţeg Basin in Romania.
Transylvanosaurus is classified in the class Ornithischia.
Transylvanosaurus belongs to the parent group Rhabdodontomorpha.
Phylogenetic analyses place Transylvanosaurus within the family Rhabdodontidae in an unresolved relationship with other members.
Researchers proposed a close relationship to Rhabdodon based on morphological comparisons.
The fossils date to the middle Maastrichtian age of the Late Cretaceous period.
Transylvanosaurus lived between 72.2 and 66 million years ago during the Maastrichtian.
